title: A Vow for the Harbor
author: Ivo Montrose
blurb: Orsen Vane, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
